lookWhy: As buildings.json, plus the cutout: a leaf is drawn cut out at alpha 0.5, so a pixel on the other side of 0.5 from Magerie's moves the leaf's edge whatever the mean says. At most 0.01% of pixels (105 at 1024) may cross it. Each board thresholds its alpha with Levels from 0.499 to 0.501, a gain of 500, so a texel whose alpha lands within 0.001 of 0.5 flips on float maths alone; those are the max-255 bytes. Measured on 9 Nov 2026: 4 to 16 pixels a board, mean 0.01. Clamping Transform's rotation to Magerie's slider, a bug found on the way, moved 3 to 9% of them.
